rec.name: Product Teaser Text (Tagline under Product Title)
rec.status: Built — fix ticket (teaser not displaying), KVA approved

what.text: A short, merchant-editable teaser line shown directly beneath the product title. It appears on collection product cards (between title and price) and in the PDP header (between title and price/badge). The text comes from a per-product rich-text metafield called 'Teaser-Texte'. Examples: 'Das perfekte Produkt für den Start' (Starter Set), 'Nachfüllpack für 6 Riegeltage' (Basic Pack REFILL). The ticket itself is a bug report that the teaser was not displaying for some products.

why.text: A one-line benefit or use-case right next to the title helps shoppers decide faster. It tells them who the product is for or what role it plays (starter, refill, add-on) without opening the PDP. This lowers cognitive load, clarifies the product ladder and makes similar SKUs easier to tell apart. Keeping the same line on the PDP reinforces the message the shopper clicked on.

how.text: 1) Create a product metafield 'Teaser-Texte' (rich text) and fill it in the product admin page (see screenshots). 2) Render the metafield in the collection card snippet, between title and price, and in the PDP title block, between title and price. 3) Add a blank-value guard so nothing renders, and no gap appears, when the metafield is empty. 4) Check that the Sectionfy-built collection and product sections actually output the metafield. The bug in the ticket was that the teaser did not show, and the screenshots suggest it was missing for some products, such as Bio Gemüsebrühe and Chili Pot. Those products have an empty or unrendered teaser, while the Refill packs show it.

items: Per-product metafield 'Teaser-Texte' (rich text: font size, bold, italic, link, bullet and numbered lists)

dependencies.text: Product metafield 'Teaser-Texte' (rich text type) defined in Shopify admin. Sectionfy sections or snippets for the collection grid and the PDP must render it. The theme must support the metafield on both collection cards and the PDP. Sectionfy's role is inferred from the ticket title.

items: Product-card CTR by SKU (starter vs. refill vs. add-on)
Conversion rate and AOV on collection and PDP sessions
